Ageas Federal Life Insurance Partners with Policybazaar for New Plan

Ageas Federal Life Insurance has launched its Super Protect Plus plan on the online insurance aggregator Policybazaar. This partnership aims to enhance the company's digital distribution channels. The Super Protect Plus plan is now available for customers to purchase through the Policybazaar platform.
